column1: # Key types Blindspot looks for. One line each, tab separated, most specific first: the first
# line whose start matches names the provider. After editing, run: bash tools/gen.sh
# A new id must also be added to PROVIDERS in gird-website worker/check-stats.js, or gird.ai
# drops it from the counts. Patterns are POSIX extended regexes that .NET reads the same way.
